Liam,

Appreciate the materials — VAT cert received. Quick answers to avoid back-and-forth:

- Please upload the VAT certificate and bank instructions to the vendor onboarding form here: https://forms.gle/vendor-onboard-form-xyZ. We prefer the certificate as a standalone PDF rather than embedded images.
- Redwood prefers the invoice "Bill To" to match the legal entity the invoice is meant for. If the trading entity is BlueBorough Logistics Ltd and is registered for VAT in the UK, invoicing that entity is fine. However our PO generator will reference the purchasing entity (Redwood EU Operations Ltd). To prevent GL reconciliation mismatches, include your VAT number and a clear remit-to bank account on the invoice and a line: "Invoiced under reverse charge where applicable" if you are zero-rating under reverse charge.
- If you have a fiscal representative (for a non-UK EU member state), please attach the appointment letter. We need it when the VAT registration country differs from the invoice country.

Next steps: fill the form and upload docs; Laura (cc'd) will confirm the PO entity mapping and estimated activation window (typically 2-4 business days once docs are validated). If you want, I can pre-seed the HubSpot vendor record (saves time).

Connor O'Brien
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Liam — good to meet earlier. Quick procurement note and PO activation checklist: 

Summary of requirements we validated with tax:
- We need your VAT registration PDF (received) and a remit-to bank account (received).
- If you intend to apply EU reverse charge on invoices to Redwood EU Operations Ltd, please include the text: "Reverse charge: Article 44 VAT Directive" (or local equivalent) and your VAT number on each invoice.
- If invoices will be issued to a different legal entity than the one on the PO, include a short note on the invoice explaining the entity relationship (e.g., "Invoiced by BlueBorough Logistics Ltd on behalf of BlueBorough Group - Redwood purchase orders to Redwood EU Operations Ltd").
- For certain member states we require a fiscal rep letter — please attach if you have one for any non-UK EU registrations.

PO entity mapping & timeline:
- PO will be issued to Redwood EU Operations Ltd (our buying entity for non-US contracts).
- Invoices directed to BlueBorough Logistics Ltd are acceptable provided they meet the invoice layout rules above.
- Once docs are complete we'll run a 48-72 business-hour validation and activate the supplier.

I've attached our internal PO-activation-checklist.pdf for your AP team — it highlights common invoice rejections (missing VAT number, incorrect bank details, mismatched entity).

If you prefer we can temporarily accept GBP invoices and handle currency conversion internally, but please flag that on the onboarding form so the PO currency is set correctly.

Laura Bennett
Vendor Enablement Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO-activation-checklist.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Liam — looping in Redwood tax to confirm a few points so you have a single list to action.

1) VAT treatment: We will treat invoices to Redwood EU Operations Ltd under the reverse charge when services are supplied under B2B rules. To support that, please ensure every invoice contains: your legal name, VAT registration number, invoice currency, VAT line (0% with reverse charge text) or VAT exemption statement, and a remit-to IBAN/BIC.

2) Fiscal representative: If any of your EU registrations are serviced by a fiscal representative, upload the signed appointment letter. If you don't have a fiscal rep, confirm the local registration country and we will treat the registration as self-managed.

3) OSS/One-Stop-Shop: If you are submitting under OSS for cross-border sales, note that OSS invoicing can differ — let us know if you are using OSS so we can advise on required invoice fields.

4) Sample invoice: attaching a sample-invoice-eu.pdf showing the preferred layout to avoid rejections.

Once you attach any outstanding docs we'll validate and mark PO-34721 for activation. If anything is time-sensitive (first invoice planned this week), tell us and procurement will prioritize.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Indirect Tax Lead, Finance
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-invoice-eu.pdf
